data.long_meaning: The name Lazaron is derived from the Hebrew word 'Elazar', which means 'God has helped'. In the Bible, Elazar is a name given to several characters including a high priest, a Levite, and a Gileadite warrior. The name is also associated with the biblical figure Lazarus, who was raised from the dead by Jesus. The name Lazaron carries the meaning “God has helped” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. in_greek.name: Λάζαρον
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λάζαρον προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα 'Eleazar', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η βοήθεια'. Στο Ευαγγέλιο του Ιωάννη, ο Λάζαρος ήταν φίλος του Ιησού, τον οποίο ανέστησε από τους νεκρούς. Το όνομα έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Lazaron
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lazaron derivatur ex hebraeo 'Eleazar', quod significat 'Deus adiutor'. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana invenitur, praesertim in relatione ad Lazarum, amicum Iesu, quem ipse a mortuis suscitavit. Nomen Lazaron significat auxilium divinum.
